Hamilton County Sheriff’s Office

## Inmate Mailroom

### Personal mail will **NO LONGER** be accepted by the Hamilton County Justice Center

### All mail sent to the facility will be returned to sender.

#### **We partner with TextBehind via HomeWAV to deliver inmate mail. All correspondence must follow the instructions below.**

###### All Personal Mail must be addressed in the following manner.

Offender First & Last Name, Control # **(Initials are not acceptable)**

Hamilton County Justice Center, OH **(do not abbreviate)**

P.O. Box 247

Phoenix, MD 21131

The mail envelope should also include the sender’s information. It should include:

- Sender’s First and Last Name (Initials are not acceptable)
- Sender’s complete return address

Any envelope without complete or missing information as specified, either for the sender or offender will be rejected and discarded UNOPENED without exception.

NOTE: TextBehind will typically set letters aside that do not have a Control # or some various piece of information. One of their team members will try to figure out the correct information. If they cannot, it will be returned to the sender with a special stamp that identifies the reason for the rejection.

TextBehind does not accept:

- Legal Mail
- Money Orders
- Driver’s Licenses
- Social Security Cards
- Credit Cards
- Debit Cards
- Personal Checks
- Gift Cards
- Cash

These unacceptable items will be returned to the sender. Anything that is not scannable is refused at the post office and sent back to the sender. Additional items that would fall into this category is books, newspapers, magazines, catalogs, advertising mailers, and junk mail. If the facility is allowing any of these items to be received, the facility will need to post a separate newspaper and/or magazine policy for where those items are to be directed.

#### **Sending Books**  **ALL BOOKS MUST COME FROM A BOOK VENDOR**  **(ex. Amazon)**

- No more than THREE (#3) books per month.

- No books containing images of drugs, alcohol, nudity, weapons, or hand gestures are permitted.

- No USED books – Books containing discoloration, stains, rips, writing in them, wire-bound, etc., will not be accepted.

- Books containing metal are not permitted.

- Pictures over 5×7 are not allowed.

- Books no thicker than 3 inches

- Nothing Poster Board-sized.

- No paper, no origami books

- No colored pencils, markers, or notebooks: These items can be purchased through the commissary.

##### **Books that do not meet these requirements will be returned to the vendor.**

##### **HOW TO ADDRESS**

**Inmate Name AND JMS Number** **900 Sycamore St.** **Cincinnati, OH 45202**

**\*\*JMS# must be included in the address or the package will be returned to the vendor. \*\***

**Acceptable Items**

 -Coloring and Puzzle Books

 -Paperback books

 -Bibles

 -Ad Magazines and Newspapers?
